title: The comparison table: three corpora, two verifiers, one harness
design:
x509-limbo, BetterTLS and PKITS, with pkix-path beside rustls-webpki, run through the same harness so the numbers are comparable rather than quoted from two projects' own READMEs.

This is the single artifact that serves both audiences: the rustls conversation needs evidence that a third-party verifier is worth the seam, and a procurement buyer needs a coverage claim that is checkable.

Blocked, genuinely rather than bureaucratically. A table built before the disagreements are classified would publish our own unexamined baseline as a coverage figure, and a table with unmeasured size and speed numbers would be the same mistake in a second column. Both prerequisites are about not shipping a number we have not looked at.

Framing, per the epic: the table should show where each verifier was designed to be strong. webpki declining policy trees and delta CRLs is not a gap in webpki, and a table that presents it as one invites the reader to discount the whole thing.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] All three corpora, both verifiers, same harness and same inputs
[ ] Per-corpus pass/fail with disagreements classified, not raw counts
[ ] Size and speed columns from the measured benchmark
[ ] States plainly which capabilities webpki declined by design rather than scoring them as failures
[ ] Re-runnable: committed with the commands that produced it
